integrity: The proof tracks two refinement fronts along the spine and separately handles balanced reflection symmetry and the unbalanced leaf split. A standalone full-graph checker verifies 14,440 parameter triples and the explicit orbit partitions.
scientific limitations: Only ordinary one-dimensional color refinement from the uniform coloring is treated.
Both pendant multiplicities are at least two; degenerate one-leaf boundary cases are excluded.
The finite checker covers p,q up to 20 and spine length up to 40; the infinite statement rests on the propagation proof.
No independent literature audit has been performed.
title: Exact color-refinement depth of nondegenerate double brooms
